from solution import count_With_Odd_SetBits


def test_issue_example_n5():
    """Example: count_With_Odd_SetBits(5) == 3."""
    # 1=1(1 odd), 2=10(1 odd), 3=11(2 even), 4=100(1 odd), 5=101(2 even) => 3
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(5) == 3


def test_issue_zero():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 0 is 0."""
    # range 1..0 is empty => 0
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(0) == 0


def test_issue_one():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 1 is 1."""
    # 1=1 has 1 set bit (odd) => 1
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(1) == 1


def test_issue_two():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 2 is 2."""
    # 1=1(1 odd), 2=10(1 odd) => 2
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(2) == 2


def test_issue_four():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 4 is 3."""
    # 1 odd, 2 odd, 3=11(2 even), 4=100(1 odd) => 3
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(4) == 3


def test_issue_six_just_above_example():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 6 is still 3."""
    # count up to 5 is 3, plus 6=110(2 even) => 3
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(6) == 3


def test_issue_seven_full_range():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 7 is 4."""
    # 0..7 has 8 numbers, half odd = 4; 0 even so 1..7 => 4
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(7) == 4


def test_issue_eight_power_of_two():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 8 is 5."""
    # count up to 7 is 4, plus 8=1000(1 odd) => 4+1=5
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(8) == 5


def test_issue_ten():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 10 is 5."""
    # odds are 1,2,4,7,8 =5; 9=1001(2 even),10=1010(2 even) => 5
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(10) == 5


def test_issue_fifteen_full_range():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 15 is 8."""
    # 0..15 has 16 numbers, half odd = 8; 0 even so 1..15 => 8
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(15) == 8


def test_issue_twenty():
    """Count of integers with odd set bits up to 20 is 10."""
    # count up to 15 is 8, plus 16 odd=>9, 17 even=>9, 18 even=>9, 19=10011(3 odd)=>10, 20=10100(2 even)=>10
    assert count_With_Odd_SetBits(20) == 10
